name: Practiced Healer
body:
You know how the body functions and so understand how best to apply positive energy.

Prerequisite(s): Heal 3 ranks, ability to cast spells which restore hit points or a class feature which restores hit points.

Benefit(s): Whenever you cast a spell or use a class feature which restores hit points you add +2 to the hit points restored for each die you would roll.

If the spell or class feature does not use dice to determine the hit points restored, such as a monk’s wholeness of body class feature, you instead add 1/2 your character level to the amount healed.
